## Description
Describe the changes introduced by this PR. Detail the problem solved or the feature added, and how the changes map to Aedile's core architecture layers.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update (no code changes)

## Checklist
- [ ] I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) document.
- [ ] My code follows the code style rules checked by `ruff`.
- [ ] My code passes all strict typing checks via `mypy`.
- [ ] I have added unit/integration tests that cover my changes.
- [ ] All new and existing tests passed via `pytest`.
- [ ] Test coverage meets or exceeds 95%.
- [ ] I have updated the documentation (`README.md`, `docs/`) to reflect these changes if applicable.
